cards.verse_text: These men will receive greater condemnation.”
cards.snippet: These men will receive greater condemnation.”

cards.card_text: Paul's last word on it: "Their condemnation is deserved!"
Paul says the judgment that followed one sin brought condemnation.
cards.verse_text: Again, the gift is not like the result of the one man’s sin: The judgment that followed one sin brought condemnation, but the gift that followed many trespasses brought justification.
cards.snippet: …of the one man’s sin: The judgment that followed one sin brought condemnation, but the gift that followed many trespasses brought justification.

cards.card_text: Paul sums it up: one trespass brought condemnation for all men.
cards.verse_text: So then, just as one trespass brought condemnation for all men, so also one act of righteousness brought justification and life for all men.
cards.snippet: So then, just as one trespass brought condemnation for all men, so also one act of righteousness brought justification and…

cards.card_text: Who will rescue me from this body of death?' (Romans 7:24) Now he says, 'Therefore, there is now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus.'
cards.verse_text: Therefore, there is now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus.
cards.snippet: Therefore, there is now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus.

cards.card_text: Paul says if the ministry of condemnation was glorious, the ministry of ___ is much more glorious.
cards.verse_text: For if the ministry of condemnation was glorious, how much more glorious is the ministry of righteousness!
cards.snippet: For if the ministry of condemnation was glorious, how much more glorious is the ministry of righteousness!

cards.card_text: Paul warns that a recent convert put in charge may become ___ and fall under condemnation.
cards.verse_text: He must not be a recent convert, or he may become conceited and fall under the same condemnation as the devil.
cards.snippet: …recent convert, or he may become conceited and fall under the same condemnation as the devil.

cards.card_text: Jude says these ungodly men were designated long ago for condemnation.
cards.verse_text: For certain men have crept in among you unnoticed—ungodly ones who were designated long ago for condemnation.
cards.snippet: …crept in among you unnoticed—ungodly ones who were designated long ago for condemnation.
